verses.1:1: It happened after the death of Moses, the servant of the LORD, that the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, the attendant of Moses, saying,
verses.1:2: "Moses My servant has died. So now, rise and cross over this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the sons of Israel.
verses.1:3: Every place where the sole of your foot will tread, to you I have given it, as I spoke to Moses.
verses.1:4: From the wilderness and this Lebanon to the great river, the Euphrates River—all the land of the Hittites—and to the Great Sea at the setting of the sun will be your territory.
verses.1:5: No man will stand firm before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, I will be with you; I will not let go of you, and I will not forsake you.
verses.1:6: Be strong and resolute, for it is you who will bring this people to inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give to them.
verses.1:7: Only be very strong and resolute, taking care to act in accordance with all the law that Moses My servant commanded you. Do not turn aside from it to the right or the left, so that you may succeed everywhere you go.
verses.1:8: This book of the law must not depart from your mouth; rather, you must meditate on it day and night, so that you may take care to act in accordance with everything written in it. For then you will make your ways prosperous, and then you will succeed.
verses.1:9: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and resolute! Do not be terrified, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you everywhere you go."
verses.1:10: So Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.1:11: "Pass through the middle of the camp and command the people, saying, 'Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are crossing over this Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving to you to possess it.'"
verses.1:12: And to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua spoke, saying,
verses.1:13: "Remember the word that Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded you, saying, 'The LORD your God is granting you rest and will give you this land.'
verses.1:14: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall stay in the land that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan, while you yourselves shall cross over armed ahead of your brothers—all the mighty warriors—and help them,
verses.1:15: until the LORD grants rest to your brothers just as to you, and they too possess the land that the LORD your God is giving to them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess that which Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave you beyond the Jordan toward the rising of the sun."
verses.1:16: And they answered Joshua, saying, "Everything that you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.
verses.1:17: In every respect as we obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the LORD your God be with you, just as He was with Moses.
verses.1:18: Every man who rebels against your command and does not heed your words in everything you command him shall be put to death. Only be strong and resolute!"
verses.2:1: Now Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim as spies, saying, "Go, look over the land and Jericho." So they went and came to the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and they stayed the night there.
verses.2:2: And it was reported to the king of Jericho, saying, "Look, men from the sons of Israel have come here tonight to scout out the land."
verses.2:3: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who came to you, who entered your house, for they have come to scout out the whole land."
verses.2:4: Now the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. And she said, "Yes, the men came to me, though I did not know where they were from.
verses.2:5: As the gate was to be shut in the dark, the men went out. I do not know where the men went; quickly pursue them, for you will overtake them."
verses.2:6: Now she had brought them up onto the roof and concealed them among the flax stalks that she had arranged on the roof.
verses.2:7: So the men pursued them along the road to the Jordan up to the fords, and they shut the gate right after those pursuing them went out.
verses.2:8: And before they had lain down, she went up to them on the roof.
verses.2:9: And she said to the men, "I know that the LORD has given the land to you, that the dread of you has fallen on us, and that all who dwell in the land have melted away before you.
verses.2:10: For we heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out from Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan—to Sihon and to Og—whom you devoted to total destruction.
verses.2:11: When we heard, our hearts melted, and no spirit endured any longer in any man because of you; for the LORD your God—He is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.
verses.2:12: Now then, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have acted with kindness toward you, that you too will act with kindness toward my father's household, and give me a sign of faithfulness,
verses.2:13: and that you will keep alive my father and my mother, my brothers and my sisters, and all that belongs to them, and rescue our lives from death."
verses.2:14: The men said to her, "Our lives in place of yours, even to death, if you do not disclose this matter of ours! Then, when the LORD gives us the land, we will act with kindness and faithfulness toward you."
verses.2:15: Then she lowered them with a rope through the window, for her house was in the side of the city wall, and it was in the wall that she lived.
verses.2:16: And she said to them, "Go to the hills, so that the pursuers do not come upon you, and hide yourselves there for three days until the pursuers return; afterward you may go on your way."
verses.2:17: Then the men said to her, "We will be free of this oath of yours that you have made us swear.
verses.2:18: Look, when we enter the land, you must tie this cord of scarlet thread in the window through which you lowered us, and gather your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father's household to yourself into the house.
verses.2:19: And it shall be that anyone who goes out from the doors of your house into the open, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be free of blame; but as for anyone who is with you in the house, his blood will be on our head if a hand is against him.
verses.2:20: And if you disclose this matter of ours, then we will be free of your oath that you have made us swear."
verses.2:21: And she said, "According to your words, so it is." She then sent them off, and they left; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.2:22: So they went and came to the hills, and stayed there for three days until the pursuers returned. Now the pursuers had searched along the entire road, yet did not find them.
verses.2:23: Then the two men turned back, descended from the hills, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun, and they recounted to him everything that had happened to them.
verses.2:24: And they said to Joshua, "Indeed, the LORD has given all the land into our hand; moreover, all who dwell in the land have melted away before us."
verses.3:1: So Joshua got up early in the morning, and they set out from Shittim and came as far as the Jordan, he and all the sons of Israel, and they spent the night there before they crossed over.
verses.3:2: It happened at the end of three days that the officers passed through the middle of the camp.
verses.3:3: And they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you yourselves shall set out from your place and walk after it.
verses.3:4: Yet there must be a distance between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not approach it, so that you may know the way in which you are to go, for you have not passed along this way previously."
verses.3:5: And Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will perform wondrous deeds in your midst."
verses.3:6: Joshua also spoke to the priests, saying, "Lift up the ark of the covenant and cross ahead of the people." So they lifted up the ark of the covenant and walked ahead of the people.
verses.3:7: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "This day I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, so that they may know that as I was with Moses, I will be with you.
verses.3:8: And as for you, you shall command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant, saying, 'When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, in the Jordan you shall stand.'"
verses.3:9: So Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "Draw near here and listen to the words of the LORD your God."
verses.3:10: And Joshua said, "By this you will know that the living God is in your midst, and that He will surely dispossess from before you the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
verses.3:11: Look, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is crossing before you into the Jordan.
verses.3:12: So now, take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one man per tribe.
verses.3:13: And it will happen that when the soles of the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off—the waters flowing down from above—and they will stand in a single heap."
verses.3:14: It happened, when the people set out from their tents to cross over the Jordan, with the priests carrying the ark of the covenant ahead of the people,
verses.3:15: and when those carrying the ark came to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests carrying the ark were dipped into the edge of the waters—now the Jordan runs full over all its banks all the days of harvest—
verses.3:16: that the waters flowing down from above stood still and rose up in a single heap, very far away, from Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those flowing down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
verses.3:17: And the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firmly on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel was crossing over on dry ground, until the entire nation had finished crossing over the Jordan.
verses.4:1: And it happened, when the whole nation had finished crossing over the Jordan, that the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take for yourselves twelve men from among the people, one man from every tribe,
verses.4:3: and command them, saying, 'Pick up for yourselves from here, from the middle of the Jordan, from the place where the priests' feet stand firmly, twelve stones, and carry them across with you and set them down at the lodging place where you will lodge tonight.'"
verses.4:4: So Joshua called to the twelve men whom he had appointed from the sons of Israel, one man from every tribe.
verses.4:5: And Joshua said to them, "Cross in front of the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you lift up one stone onto his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel,
verses.4:6: so that this may be a sign in your midst. When your children ask in time to come, saying, 'What are these stones to you?'
verses.4:7: then you shall tell them that the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it crossed through the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. Thus these stones shall be a memorial for the sons of Israel forever."
verses.4:8: And the sons of Israel did so, just as Joshua commanded; they picked up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, just as the LORD had spoken to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel, and they carried them across with them to the lodging place and set them down there.
verses.4:9: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, under the place where the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant stood, and they have been there to this day.
verses.4:10: Meanwhile, the priests carrying the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until every matter that the LORD had commanded Joshua to speak to the people was finished, in accordance with all that Moses had commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and crossed over.
verses.4:11: And when all the people had finished crossing over, the ark of the LORD and the priests crossed over before the people.
verses.4:12: The sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over in battle array ahead of the sons of Israel, just as Moses had spoken to them.
verses.4:13: About forty thousand men armed for military service crossed over before the LORD for battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.4:14: On that day the LORD made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel, and they stood in awe of him as they had stood in awe of Moses all the days of his life.
verses.4:15: And the LORD spoke to Joshua:
verses.4:16: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the testimony that they come up out of the Jordan."
verses.4:17: Then Joshua commanded the priests, saying, "Come up out of the Jordan."
verses.4:18: And it happened, as soon as the priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up from the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up onto the dry ground, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and flowed over all its banks as before.
verses.4:19: Now the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth of the first month, and they encamped at Gilgal, on the eastern edge of Jericho.
verses.4:20: And Joshua set up at Gilgal these twelve stones that they had taken from the Jordan.
verses.4:21: He spoke to the sons of Israel, saying, "When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, 'What are these stones?'
verses.4:22: then you shall let your children know, saying, 'On dry land Israel crossed over this Jordan.'
verses.4:23: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you crossed over, just as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, which He dried up from before us until we crossed over,
verses.4:24: so that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty, and so that you may fear the LORD your God always."
verses.5:1: And it happened, when all the kings of the Amorites who were across the Jordan to the west and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the sons of Israel until they had crossed over, that their hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in them because of the sons of Israel.
verses.5:2: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, "Make for yourself flint knives, and again circumcise the sons of Israel a second time."
verses.5:3: So Joshua made flint knives for himself and circumcised the sons of Israel at the Hill of the Foreskins.
verses.5:4: Now this is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, the males, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness along the way after coming out of Egypt.
verses.5:5: For all the people who came out were circumcised, yet none of the people born in the wilderness along the way after they came out of Egypt had been circumcised.
verses.5:6: For forty years the sons of Israel walked in the wilderness until the entire nation, the men of war who came out of Egypt, had come to an end, because they did not listen to the voice of the LORD; to them the LORD had sworn that He would not let them see the land that the LORD had sworn to their fathers to give to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.5:7: As for their sons whom He raised up in their place, Joshua circumcised them; for they were uncircumcised, since they had not been circumcised on the way.
verses.5:8: And when the whole nation had finished being circumcised, they remained in their places in the camp until they had recovered.
verses.5:9: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "This day I have rolled away the disgrace of Egypt from off you." Therefore the name of that place has been called Gilgal down to this day.
verses.5:10: And the sons of Israel encamped at Gilgal, and they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the plains of Jericho.
verses.5:11: On the day after the Passover they ate from the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and roasted grain, on that very same day.
verses.5:12: And the manna ceased on the following day, when they ate from the produce of the land; there was no longer any manna for the sons of Israel, but they ate from the yield of the land of Canaan in that year.
verses.5:13: And it happened, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and look, a man stood opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went over to him and said to him, "Are you for us, or for our foes?"
verses.5:14: And he said, "No; rather, I am commander of the army of the LORD; now I have come." Then Joshua fell on his face to the ground and bowed down, and he said to him, "What is my lord speaking to his servant?"
verses.5:15: The commander of the army of the LORD said to Joshua, "Take your sandal off your foot, for the place on which you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.
verses.6:1: Now Jericho was closed and tightly shut up because of the sons of Israel; no one was going out and no one was coming in.
verses.6:2: And the LORD said to Joshua, "Look, I have given into your hand Jericho and its king, the mighty warriors.
verses.6:3: You shall march around the city, all the men of war, circling the city one time. So you shall do for six days.
verses.6:5: And it shall be that when they sound a long blast on the ram's horn, as soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout a great shout; then the wall of the city will fall down in its place, and the people will go up, each man straight ahead of him."
verses.6:6: So Joshua son of Nun called to the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven ram's-horn trumpets ahead of the ark of the LORD."
verses.6:7: And he said to the people, "Move forward and march around the city, and let the armed men pass on ahead of the ark of the LORD."
verses.6:8: And it happened, when Joshua had spoken to the people, that the seven priests carrying the seven ram's-horn trumpets before the LORD moved forward and blew the trumpets, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD went along behind them.
verses.6:9: The armed men went ahead of the priests who were blowing the trumpets, and the rear guard went behind the ark, while the trumpets kept blowing as they went.
verses.6:10: Now Joshua commanded the people, saying, "You are not to shout, nor make your voice heard, nor let any word come out from your mouth until the day I say to you, 'Shout!' Then you shall shout."
verses.6:11: So he had the ark of the LORD go around the city, circling it one time; then they came into the camp and lodged in the camp.
verses.6:12: Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests lifted up the ark of the LORD.
verses.6:13: The seven priests carrying the seven ram's-horn trumpets ahead of the ark of the LORD marched on continually and blew the trumpets; the armed men went ahead of them, and the rear guard went behind the ark of the LORD, while the trumpets kept blowing as they went.
verses.6:14: On the second day they marched around the city one time and returned to the camp. That is what they did for six days.
verses.6:15: Then on the seventh day they got up early at the rising of dawn and marched around the city in this same manner seven times; only on that day they marched around the city seven times.
verses.6:16: And on the seventh time, as the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, "Shout, for the LORD has given the city to you!
verses.6:17: The city shall be devoted to destruction, both it and everything in it, for the LORD; only Rahab the prostitute shall stay alive, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.
verses.6:18: Only you yourselves, keep away from what is devoted to destruction, so that you do not devote yourselves to destruction by taking from what is devoted to destruction, and turn the camp of Israel into something devoted to destruction and bring trouble on it.
verses.6:19: Yet all silver and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, are holy to the LORD; into the LORD's treasury they shall go."
verses.6:20: So the people shouted, and they blew the trumpets. And it happened, as soon as the people heard the sound of the trumpet, that the people shouted a great shout, and the wall fell down in its place; then the people went up into the city, each man straight ahead of him, and they captured the city.
verses.6:21: And they devoted to destruction all that was in the city, from man to woman, from young to old, and even ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
verses.6:22: But to the two men who had spied out the land Joshua said, "Enter the house of the prostitute woman, and bring out from there the woman and all that belongs to her, just as you swore to her."
verses.6:23: So the young men who were spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that belonged to her; they also brought out all her families, and they settled them outside the camp of Israel.
verses.6:24: Then they burned the city with fire, and everything that was in it; only the silver and the gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they placed into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
verses.6:25: Yet Joshua kept alive Rahab the prostitute, her father's household, and all that belonged to her; and she has lived in the midst of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.6:26: At that time Joshua imposed an oath, saying, "Cursed is the man before the LORD who rises up and builds this city, Jericho: at the price of his firstborn he shall lay its foundation, and at the price of his youngest he shall set up its gates."
verses.6:27: And the LORD was with Joshua, and his renown was throughout all the land.
verses.7:1: But the sons of Israel committed an act of unfaithfulness concerning what was devoted to destruction, for Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was devoted to destruction, so the LORD's anger burned against the sons of Israel.
verses.7:2: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and he said to them, "Go up and scout out the land." So the men went up and scouted out Ai.
verses.7:3: They returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not let all the people go up; let about two thousand men or about three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Do not wear out all the people going there, for they are few."
verses.7:4: So about three thousand men from the people went up there, but they fled before the men of Ai.
verses.7:5: The men of Ai struck down about thirty-six men from among them, and they pursued them from before the gate as far as Shebarim and struck them down on the descent. Then the heart of the people melted and turned to water.
verses.7:6: Then Joshua tore his garments and fell on his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD until the evening, he and the elders of Israel, and they cast dust on their heads.
verses.7:7: Joshua said, "Alas, Lord GOD, why did You bring this people across the Jordan at all, to give us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
verses.7:8: Please, Lord, what can I say after Israel has turned its back before its enemies?
verses.7:9: The Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?"
verses.7:10: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Get up! Why is it that you have fallen on your face?
verses.7:11: Israel has sinned; they have also transgressed My covenant that I commanded them. They have also taken some of what was devoted to destruction, they have also stolen, they have also acted deceptively, and they have also placed it among their belongings.
verses.7:12: Therefore the sons of Israel cannot stand before their enemies; they turn their backs before their enemies because they have become devoted to destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you destroy what is devoted to destruction from your midst.
verses.7:13: Get up, consecrate the people, and say, 'Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: "Something devoted to destruction is in your midst, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you remove what is devoted to destruction from your midst."
verses.7:14: In the morning you shall be brought forward by your tribes. The tribe that the LORD takes shall come forward by clans, and the clan that the LORD takes shall come forward by households, and the household that the LORD takes shall come forward man by man.
verses.7:15: And the one who is taken with what is devoted to destruction shall be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and because he has committed a disgraceful act in Israel.'"
verses.7:16: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel forward by its tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
verses.7:17: He brought the clans of Judah forward, and he took the clan of the Zerahites; then he brought the clan of the Zerahites forward man by man, and Zabdi was taken.
verses.7:18: He brought his household forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
verses.7:19: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, please ascribe glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and give confession to Him. Tell me now what you have done; do not conceal it from me."
verses.7:20: So Achan answered Joshua and said, "Indeed, I myself have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done:
verses.7:21: I saw among the plunder one fine cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and an ingot of gold weighing fifty shekels; then I coveted them and took them. Now they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath it."
verses.7:22: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath it.
verses.7:23: They took them out from inside the tent, brought them to Joshua and to all the sons of Israel, and poured them out before the LORD.
verses.7:24: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the cloak, the ingot of gold, his sons, his daughters, his oxen, his donkeys, his flock, his tent, and all that belonged to him, and they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.
verses.7:25: Joshua said, "Why have you brought trouble on us? The LORD will bring trouble on you today!" Then all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.
verses.7:26: They raised a large heap of stones over him, which remains to this day; and the LORD turned from His burning anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Achor to this day.
verses.8:1: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Take all the fighting men with you, and get up and go up to Ai. See, I have given the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land into your hand.
verses.8:2: You shall do to Ai and its king just as you did to Jericho and its king; only its plunder and its livestock you may take as booty for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it."
verses.8:3: So Joshua and all the fighting men rose to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, valiant warriors, and sent them out by night.
verses.8:4: He commanded them, saying, "See, you are to lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Do not go very far from the city, and let all of you be ready.
verses.8:5: Then I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. When they come out to meet us as at the first, we will flee before them.
verses.8:6: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, 'They are fleeing before us as at the first.' So we will flee before them.
verses.8:7: Then you shall rise up from the ambush and take possession of the city, for the LORD your God will give it into your hand.
verses.8:8: And when you have seized the city, you shall set the city on fire; you shall act according to the word of the LORD. See, I have commanded you."
verses.8:9: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the place of ambush and stayed between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai; but Joshua spent that night among the people.
verses.8:10: Joshua rose early in the morning and mustered the people; then he and the elders of Israel went up before the people to Ai.
verses.8:11: All the fighting men who were with him went up, drew near, and arrived opposite the city; and they encamped north of Ai, with the ravine between him and Ai.
verses.8:12: He took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, west of the city.
verses.8:14: When the king of Ai saw it, the men of the city hurried, rose early, and went out to meet Israel for battle, he and all his people, to the appointed place facing the Arabah; for he did not know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.
verses.8:15: Joshua and all Israel allowed themselves to be beaten before them, and they fled by way of the wilderness.
verses.8:16: All the people who were in Ai were summoned to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
verses.8:17: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel; they left the city open and pursued Israel.
verses.8:18: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand." So Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.
verses.8:19: The ambush party rose quickly from its place, and as soon as he stretched out his hand they ran, entered the city, and captured it; and they hurried and set the city on fire.
verses.8:20: When the men of Ai turned around behind them and looked, there was the smoke of the city rising to the sky, and they had no power to flee this way or that, for the people fleeing to the wilderness turned back against the pursuers.
verses.8:21: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush party had captured the city and that the smoke of the city was rising, they turned back and struck down the men of Ai.
verses.8:22: The others came out from the city to meet them, so they were caught in the middle of Israel, some on one side and some on the other; and they struck them down until they left them neither survivor nor escapee.
verses.8:23: But they seized the king of Ai alive and brought him before Joshua.
verses.8:24: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they had pursued them, and all of them had fallen by the edge of the sword to the very last one, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
verses.8:25: All who fell that day, both men and women, totaled twelve thousand, all the people of Ai.
verses.8:27: Only the livestock and the plunder of that city Israel took as booty for themselves, according to the word of the LORD that He had commanded Joshua.
verses.8:28: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent mound of ruins, a desolation to this day.
verses.8:29: And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening time; then at sunset Joshua gave a command, and they took his corpse down from the tree, threw it at the entrance of the city gate, and raised a large heap of stones over him, which remains to this day.
verses.9:1: Now it happened when all the kings who were beyond the Jordan—in the hill country, in the lowland, and along all the coast of the Great Sea facing Lebanon, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites—heard,
verses.9:2: they assembled together to fight against Joshua and against Israel with one voice.
verses.9:3: Now the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
verses.9:4: and they too acted with cunning; they went out and posed as envoys, and took worn-out sacks for their donkeys and worn-out wineskins, split open and tied up,
verses.9:5: with worn-out and patched sandals on their feet and worn-out garments on them; and all the bread of their provisions had dried out and turned to crumbs.
verses.9:6: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, "We have come from a distant land; so now, make a covenant with us."
verses.9:7: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, "Perhaps you live among us; how then can we make a covenant with you?"
verses.9:8: And they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." Then Joshua said to them, "Who are you, and where do you come from?"
verses.9:9: They said to him, "From a very distant land your servants have come because of the name of the LORD your God, for we have heard the report of Him and all that He did in Egypt,
verses.9:10: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was in Ashtaroth.
verses.9:11: So our elders and all the inhabitants of our land spoke to us, saying, 'Take provisions in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; so now, make a covenant with us."'
verses.9:12: This bread of ours, we packed it hot as provisions from our houses on the day we set out to come to you; and now, look, it is dry and has turned to crumbs.
verses.9:13: And these wineskins that we filled were new, and look, they have burst open; and these garments and sandals of ours have worn out because of the exceedingly long journey."
verses.9:14: So the men took some of their provisions, but they did not inquire of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.9:15: And Joshua made peace with them and made a covenant with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore to them.
verses.9:16: And it happened at the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were near to them and were living in their midst.
verses.9:17: Then the sons of Israel set out and arrived at their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
verses.9:18: Yet the sons of Israel did not strike them down, because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. And the whole congregation grumbled against the leaders.
verses.9:19: But all the leaders said to the whole congregation, "We ourselves have sworn to them by the LORD, the God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.
verses.9:20: This is what we will do to them: we will let them live, so that wrath will not come upon us because of the oath that we swore to them."
verses.9:21: And the leaders said to them, "Let them live." So they became cutters of wood and drawers of water for the entire congregation, just as the leaders had spoken to them.
verses.9:22: Then Joshua summoned them and spoke to them, saying, "Why have you deceived us, saying, 'We are very far from you,' when you are living in our midst?
verses.9:23: Now therefore, you are cursed, and there shall never fail to be from among you slaves—cutters of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God."
verses.9:24: So they answered Joshua and said, "Because it was surely told to your servants what the LORD your God had commanded His servant Moses: to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we feared greatly for our lives because of you, and we have done this thing.
verses.9:25: Now here we are in your hand; do as is good and right in your eyes to do to us."
verses.9:26: So he did this for them: he rescued them from the hand of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.
verses.9:27: And on that day Joshua appointed them cutters of wood and drawers of water for the congregation and for the altar of the LORD, to this day, at the place that He would choose.
verses.10:1: Now it happened when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and had devoted it to destruction—just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king—and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
verses.10:2: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty warriors.
verses.10:3: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.10:4: "Come up to me and help me, and let us strike Gibeon, for it has made peace with Joshua and with the sons of Israel."
verses.10:5: So the five kings of the Amorites—the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon—gathered together and went up, they and all their armies, and they encamped against Gibeon and fought against it.
verses.10:6: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, "Do not withdraw your hands from your servants; come up to us quickly and save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who inhabit the hill country have gathered against us."
verses.10:7: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the fighting force with him and all the mighty men of valor.
verses.10:8: And the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have given them into your hand; not a man of them shall stand before you."
verses.10:9: So Joshua came upon them suddenly, having gone up all night from Gilgal.
verses.10:10: And the LORD threw them into panic before Israel, and struck them down with a great defeat at Gibeon, and pursued them along the road of the ascent of Beth-horon, and struck them as far as Azekah and as far as Makkedah.
verses.10:11: And it happened as they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth-horon, that the LORD hurled large stones down on them from the sky as far as Azekah, and they died; there were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword.
verses.10:12: Then Joshua spoke to the LORD on the day the LORD handed over the Amorites before the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, "Sun, be still at Gibeon, and moon, in the Valley of Aijalon!"
verses.10:13: So the sun was still, and the moon stood in place, until the nation took vengeance on its enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? And the sun stood in the middle of the sky and did not hurry to go down for about a full day.
verses.10:14: And there was no day like that one, either before it or after it, in which the LORD listened to the voice of a man, for the LORD was fighting for Israel.
verses.10:16: Now these five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.10:17: And it was told to Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
verses.10:18: So Joshua said, "Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave and station men by it to guard them,
verses.10:19: but as for you, do not stay there; pursue after your enemies and attack them from the rear. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for the LORD your God has given them into your hand."
verses.10:20: Now it happened when Joshua and the sons of Israel had finished striking them down with a very great defeat until they were wiped out—and the survivors among them who escaped entered the fortified cities—
verses.10:21: that all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. No one sharpened his tongue against any of the sons of Israel.
verses.10:22: Then Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring these five kings out to me from the cave."
verses.10:23: They did so, and brought these five kings out to him from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.10:24: And when they had brought these kings out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all the men of Israel and said to the commanders of the men of war who had gone with him, "Come near, place your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came near and placed their feet on their necks.
verses.10:25: Then Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed; be strong and courageous, for this is what the LORD will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
verses.10:26: And afterward Joshua struck them and put them to death, and he hanged them on five trees; and they remained hanging on the trees until evening.
verses.10:27: And it happened at the time of sunset that Joshua gave a command, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves; and they placed large stones over the mouth of the cave, remaining to this very day.
verses.10:28: Now Joshua captured Makkedah on that day and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword; he devoted them and every person who was in it to destruction, and he left no survivor. And he did to the king of Makkedah just as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:29: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, passed on from Makkedah to Libnah, and he fought against Libnah.
verses.10:30: And the LORD gave it also and its king into the hand of Israel, and he struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword; he left no survivor in it. And he did to its king just as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.10:31: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, passed on from Libnah to Lachish, and he encamped against it and fought against it.
verses.10:32: And the LORD gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he captured it on the second day and struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.10:33: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish, and Joshua struck him and his people until he left him no survivor.
verses.10:34: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, passed on from Lachish to Eglon, and they encamped against it and fought against it.
verses.10:35: And they captured it on that day and struck it with the edge of the sword; and every person who was in it he devoted to destruction on that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.10:36: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, went up from Eglon to Hebron, and they fought against it.
verses.10:37: And they captured it and struck it, its king, all its cities, and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword; he left no survivor, according to all that he had done to Eglon, and he devoted it and every person who was in it to destruction.
verses.10:38: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, turned back to Debir, and he fought against it.
verses.10:39: And he captured it, its king, and all its cities, and they struck them with the edge of the sword and devoted every person who was in it to destruction; he left no survivor. Just as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and to its king, and just as he had done to Libnah and to its king.
verses.10:40: So Joshua struck the entire land—the hill country and the Negev and the lowland and the slopes—and all their kings; he left no survivor, and he devoted everything that breathed to destruction, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.10:41: And Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea even to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen even to Gibeon.
verses.10:42: And Joshua captured all these kings and their land at one time, because the LORD, the God of Israel, was fighting for Israel.
verses.11:1: Now it happened, when Jabin, king of Hazor, heard this, that he sent to Jobab, king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.11:2: and to the kings who were in the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the uplands of Dor on the west;
verses.11:3: the Canaanites on the east and on the west, and the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, and the Jebusites in the hill country, and the Hivites below Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.11:4: Then they went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, like the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, and very many horses and chariots.
verses.11:5: All these kings assembled, and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
verses.11:6: And the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, for about this time tomorrow I am giving all of them over dead before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses, and you are to burn their chariots with fire."
verses.11:7: Then Joshua and all the fighting men with him came upon them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and they fell upon them.
verses.11:8: The LORD gave them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them down and pursued them as far as Great Sidon, and as far as Misrephoth-maim, and as far as the valley of Mizpeh toward the east; and they struck them until they left them no survivor.
verses.11:9: Then Joshua did to them as the LORD had said to him: he hamstrung their horses, and he burned their chariots with fire.
verses.11:10: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor, and he struck its king down with the sword, for previously Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.
verses.11:11: They struck down every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, devoting them to destruction; not one who breathed remained. And he burned Hazor with fire.
verses.11:12: And Joshua captured all the cities of these kings and all their kings, and he struck them down with the edge of the sword; he devoted them to destruction, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded.
verses.11:13: Yet Israel burned none of the cities standing on their mounds, apart from Hazor alone, which Joshua burned.
verses.11:14: The sons of Israel took for themselves as plunder all the spoil of these cities and the livestock; however, they struck down every human being with the edge of the sword until they had destroyed them; they left not one who breathed.
verses.11:15: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did; he did not set aside a single thing from all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.11:16: So Joshua took all this land: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, as well as the hill country of Israel and its lowland,
verses.11:17: from Mount Halak, which ascends toward Seir, all the way to Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings, and he struck them down and put them to death.
verses.11:18: For many days Joshua waged war with all these kings.
verses.11:19: Not a single city made peace with the sons of Israel except the Hivites, the residents of Gibeon; they took all of them in battle.
verses.11:20: For it was from the LORD to harden their hearts so that they would face Israel in battle, in order to devote them to destruction, so that there would be no mercy for them, but rather to destroy them, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.11:21: At that time Joshua came and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel; together with their cities, Joshua devoted them to destruction.
verses.11:22: No Anakim remained in the land of the sons of Israel; only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod were some left.
verses.11:23: Thus Joshua took all the land, in accordance with everything that the LORD had spoken to Moses, and Joshua gave it to Israel as an inheritance according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.12:1: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel struck down, and whose land they took possession of, across the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah on the east:
verses.12:2: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer, which is on the rim of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half of Gilead, as far as the Jabbok valley, the border of the sons of Ammon,
verses.12:3: and the Arabah to the Sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, on the east, in the direction of Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah;
verses.12:4: and the territory of Og, king of Bashan, from the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei,
verses.12:5: and ruling over Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and over half of Gilead to the border of Sihon, king of Heshbon.
verses.12:6: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the sons of Israel struck them down; and Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave it as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.12:7: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the sons of Israel struck down across the Jordan westward, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which ascends toward Seir; and Joshua gave it as a possession to the tribes of Israel according to their divisions,
verses.12:8: in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, on the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negev—the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.12:9: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is next to Bethel, one;
verses.12:10: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.12:11: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.12:12: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
verses.12:13: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.12:14: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.12:15: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.12:16: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
verses.12:17: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.12:18: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
verses.12:19: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.12:20: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.12:21: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.12:22: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
verses.12:23: the king of Dor in the upland of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
verses.12:24: the king of Tirzah, one; thirty-one kings altogether.
verses.13:1: Now Joshua was old, far along in years, and the LORD said to him, "You have grown old, far along in years, yet a very great amount of the land remains to be possessed.
verses.13:2: This is the remaining land: all the districts of the Philistines and all the Geshurites,
verses.13:3: from the Shihor, which lies east of Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron to the north—it is reckoned as belonging to the Canaanites—the five rulers of the Philistines: the Gazites, the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
verses.13:4: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah, which belongs to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites,
verses.13:5: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon toward the sunrise, from Baal-gad beneath Mount Hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.
verses.13:6: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon as far as Misrephoth-maim, all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive them out before the sons of Israel. Only allot it to Israel as an inheritance, just as I commanded you.
verses.13:7: So now, divide this land as an inheritance for the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh."
verses.13:8: With him, the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them:
verses.13:9: from Aroer, which is on the rim of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon;
verses.13:10: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the sons of Ammon;
verses.13:11: and Gilead, and the territory of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah;
verses.13:12: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei. He remained from the remnant of the Rephaim, and Moses struck them down and drove them out.
verses.13:13: However, the sons of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites, and Geshur and Maacath have lived in the midst of Israel until this day.
verses.13:14: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance; the fire offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, are his inheritance, just as He spoke to him.
verses.13:15: And Moses gave to the tribe of the sons of Reuben according to their clans.
verses.13:16: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the rim of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plateau by Medeba;
verses.13:17: Heshbon and all its cities that are on the plateau: Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
verses.13:19: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,
verses.13:20: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.13:21: and all the cities of the plateau, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck down along with the leaders of Midian—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, inhabitants of the land.
verses.13:22: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword, in addition to those they struck down.
verses.13:23: The border of the sons of Reuben was the Jordan and its borderland. This was the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
verses.13:24: Moses also gave to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad, according to their clans.
verses.13:25: Their territory was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, as far as Aroer, which lies east of Rabbah;
verses.13:26: and from Heshbon as far as Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim as far as the border of Debir;
verses.13:27: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan and its borderland, as far as the end of the Sea of Chinnereth, beyond the Jordan to the east.
verses.13:28: This was the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
verses.13:29: Moses also gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh; and it belonged to the half-tribe of the sons of Manasseh according to their clans.
verses.13:30: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all Havvoth-jair, which is in Bashan, sixty cities;
verses.13:31: and half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, belonged to the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, to half of the sons of Machir according to their clans.
verses.13:32: These are the portions that Moses assigned as an inheritance in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan by Jericho, to the east.
verses.14:1: Now these are the portions that the sons of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel assigned to them,
verses.14:2: by the lot of their inheritance, just as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
verses.14:3: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan, yet he gave the Levites no inheritance in their midst.
verses.14:4: For the sons of Joseph formed two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and they gave the Levites no share in the land, except cities to live in, along with their pasturelands for their livestock and for their possessions.
verses.14:5: Just as the LORD had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.14:6: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You yourself know the word that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you at Kadesh-barnea.
verses.14:7: I was forty years of age when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to scout out the land, and I brought him back a report according to what was in my heart.
verses.14:8: Yet my brothers who went up with me caused the heart of the people to melt, whereas I completely followed the LORD my God.
verses.14:9: And Moses swore on that day, saying, 'Surely the land on which your foot has stepped will belong to you as an inheritance, and to your sons forever, because you have completely followed the LORD my God.'
verses.14:10: And now, look, the LORD has kept me alive, just as He spoke, these forty-five years from the time the LORD spoke this word to Moses, during which Israel walked in the wilderness; and now, here I am today, eighty-five years of age.
verses.14:11: Today I am still as strong as on the day Moses sent me; just as my strength was then, so is my strength now, for war, to go out and to come in.
verses.14:12: So now, give me this hill country about which the LORD spoke on that day, for you yourself heard on that day that Anakim are there, along with large fortified cities. Perhaps the LORD will be with me, and I will drive them out, just as the LORD spoke."
verses.14:13: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.
verses.14:14: For this reason Hebron has belonged to Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance until this day, because he completely followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.14:15: Now the name of Hebron previously was Kiriath-arba; he was the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land rested from war.
verses.15:1: The lot for the tribe of the sons of Judah, by their clans, extended to the boundary of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the far end of the south.
verses.15:2: Their southern boundary was from the end of the Salt Sea, from the inlet that faces southward.
verses.15:3: It went out to the south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to Zin, and went up south of Kadesh-barnea; then it passed on to Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned around to Karka.
verses.15:4: It passed on to Azmon and went out to the Brook of Egypt, and the endpoints of the boundary were at the sea. This will be your southern boundary.
verses.15:5: The eastern boundary was the Salt Sea as far as the end of the Jordan. And the boundary for the northern side was from the inlet of the sea, at the end of the Jordan.
verses.15:6: Then the boundary went up to Beth-hoglah and passed north of Beth-arabah, and the boundary went up to the stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
verses.15:7: The boundary went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning northward toward Gilgal, which is opposite the Ascent of Adummim, which lies south of the brook. Then the boundary passed on to the waters of En-shemesh, and its endpoints were at En-rogel.
verses.15:8: Then the boundary went up the Valley of the son of Hinnom to the southern flank of the Jebusite, that is, Jerusalem. And the boundary went up to the summit of the mountain that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, which is at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.15:9: Then the boundary curved from the summit of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the boundary curved to Baalah, that is, Kiriath-jearim.
verses.15:10: Then the boundary turned around from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, passed on to the northern flank of Mount Jearim, that is, Chesalon, went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.
verses.15:11: The boundary went out to the northern flank of Ekron, and the boundary curved to Shikkeron, passed on to Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel; and the endpoints of the boundary were at the sea.
verses.15:12: The western boundary was the Great Sea and its coastline. This is the boundary of the sons of Judah all around, by their clans.
verses.15:13: To Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the sons of Judah, at the command of the LORD to Joshua: Kiriath-arba—Arba was the father of Anak—that is, Hebron.
verses.15:14: From there Caleb dispossessed the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the offspring of Anak.
verses.15:15: From there he went up against the residents of Debir; previously the name of Debir was Kiriath-sepher.
verses.15:16: Caleb said, "Anyone who strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as a wife."
verses.15:17: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, captured it, and he gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.
verses.15:18: Now when she came, she urged him to ask her father for a field. Then she dismounted from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"
verses.15:19: She said, "Give me a blessing: for you have given me the land of the Negev, so give me springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.15:20: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah, by their clans.
verses.15:21: The cities at the far end of the tribe of the sons of Judah, toward the boundary of Edom in the Negev, were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur;
verses.15:25: Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-hezron, that is, Hazor;
verses.15:32: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon: a total of twenty-nine cities and their villages.
verses.15:33: In the lowland: Eshtaol, Zorah, and Ashnah;
verses.15:36: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim: fourteen cities and their villages.
verses.15:41: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities and their villages.
verses.15:44: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities and their villages.
verses.15:45: Ekron, with its dependent towns and its villages;
verses.15:46: from Ekron westward, all that lay alongside Ashdod and their villages;
verses.15:47: Ashdod, its dependent towns, and its villages; Gaza, its dependent towns, and its villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt, with the Great Sea and its coastline.
verses.15:48: And in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh;
verses.15:49: Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah, that is, Debir;
verses.15:51: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh: eleven cities and their villages.
verses.15:54: Humtah, Kiriath-arba—that is, Hebron—and Zior: nine cities and their villages.
verses.15:57: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah: ten cities and their villages.
verses.15:59: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon: six cities and their villages.
verses.15:60: Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—and Rabbah: two cities and their villages.
verses.15:61: In the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah;
verses.15:62: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi: six cities and their villages.
verses.15:63: But as for the Jebusites, the residents of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah were unable to dispossess them; so the Jebusites have lived with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.16:1: Now the lot came out for the sons of Joseph, from the Jordan by Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, into the wilderness, ascending from Jericho into the hill country to Bethel.
verses.16:2: It went out from Bethel to Luz and passed over to the boundary of the Archites at Ataroth.
verses.16:3: Then it descended westward to the boundary of the Japhletites, as far as the boundary of Lower Beth-horon and as far as Gezer, and its outer limits were at the sea.
verses.16:4: And the sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.16:5: Now the boundary of the sons of Ephraim by their clans was this: the boundary of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon.
verses.16:6: Then the boundary went out toward the sea, at Michmethath on the north, and the boundary turned eastward to Taanath-shiloh and passed by it on the east of Janoah.
verses.16:7: It descended from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, reached Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
verses.16:8: From Tappuah the boundary ran westward to the wadi of Kanah, and its outer limits were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim by their clans,
verses.16:9: along with the cities set apart for the sons of Ephraim within the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.
verses.16:10: Yet they did not dispossess the Canaanites living in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and they became subject to forced labor.
verses.17:1: Then the lot was for the tribe of Manasseh, because he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, since he was a man of war, Gilead and Bashan belonged to him.
verses.17:2: There was also a lot for the remaining sons of Manasseh by their clans: for the sons of Abiezer, the sons of Helek, the sons of Asriel, the sons of Shechem, the sons of Hepher, and the sons of Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh, son of Joseph, by their clans.
verses.17:3: Now Zelophehad, son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.17:4: They came before Eleazar the priest, before Joshua son of Nun, and before the leaders, saying, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our kinsmen." So according to the command of the LORD, he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
verses.17:5: So ten portions fell to Manasseh, apart from the land of Gilead and Bashan, which lies across the Jordan.
verses.17:6: For the daughters of Manasseh obtained an inheritance among his sons, and the land of Gilead belonged to the remaining sons of Manasseh.
verses.17:7: Now the boundary of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which faces Shechem, and the boundary went southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.17:8: To Manasseh belonged the land of Tappuah, while Tappuah at the boundary of Manasseh belonged to the sons of Ephraim.
verses.17:9: Then the boundary descended to the wadi of Kanah, south of the wadi. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh, while the boundary of Manasseh was north of the wadi, and its outer limits were at the sea.
verses.17:10: To the south it belonged to Ephraim, and to the north to Manasseh, and the sea was its boundary; and they reached Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
verses.17:11: Also in Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its surrounding towns, Ibleam and its surrounding towns, the inhabitants of Dor and its surrounding towns, the inhabitants of En-dor and its surrounding towns, the inhabitants of Taanach and its surrounding towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its surrounding towns, the three heights.
verses.17:12: Yet the sons of Manasseh were unable to dispossess these cities, and the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.
verses.17:13: Then, when the sons of Israel grew strong, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor, yet they did not completely dispossess them.
verses.17:14: The sons of Joseph spoke with Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me one lot and one portion as an inheritance, when I am a numerous people, since the LORD has blessed me thus far?"
verses.17:15: Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up into the forest and clear ground for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, because the hill country of Ephraim is too cramped for you."
verses.17:16: And the sons of Joseph said, "The hill country will not suffice for us, and all the Canaanites living in the land of the valley have iron chariots, both those in Beth-shean and its surrounding towns and those in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.17:17: Then Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, "You are a numerous people, and great strength is yours; you will not have just one lot,
verses.17:18: but the hill country will be yours. Though it is a forest, you will clear it, and its outer limits will be yours; for you will dispossess the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and even though they are strong."
verses.18:1: Then the entire congregation of the sons of Israel gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there; and the land had been subdued before them.
verses.18:2: However, seven tribes were left among the sons of Israel who had not divided up their inheritance.
verses.18:3: Then Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "How long will you be slack about entering to possess the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
verses.18:4: Provide for yourselves three men for each tribe, that I may send them; and they will rise, walk about through the land, record it in writing according to their inheritance, and come to me.
verses.18:5: They will divide it among themselves into seven divisions: Judah will remain within its boundary on the south, and the house of Joseph will remain within their boundary on the north.
verses.18:6: And you yourselves will record the land in writing in seven divisions and bring it here to me, and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.18:7: For the Levites have no share in your midst, since the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance; and Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have taken their inheritance across the Jordan to the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them."
verses.18:8: So the men rose and set out, and Joshua commanded those going to record the land in writing, saying, "Go, walk about through the land, record it in writing, and return to me; and here I will cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh."
verses.18:9: The men went, passed through the land, and recorded it in writing by cities in seven divisions on a scroll; then they came to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
verses.18:10: Then Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before the LORD, and Joshua apportioned the land there for the sons of Israel by their divisions.
verses.18:11: Now the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up by their clans, and the boundary of their lot came out between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.
verses.18:12: Their boundary on the north side was from the Jordan; the boundary ascended to the slope of Jericho on the north and ascended into the hill country westward, and its outer limits were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.18:13: From there the boundary passed over to Luz, to the southern slope of Luz—that is, Bethel—and the boundary descended to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.
verses.18:14: Then the boundary curved and turned on the west side southward, from the mountain that faces Beth-horon on the south, and its outer limits were at Kiriath-baal—that is, Kiriath-jearim—a city of the sons of Judah. This is the west side.
verses.18:15: And the south side was from the edge of Kiriath-jearim; the boundary went out westward and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.18:16: Then the boundary descended to the edge of the mountain that faces the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is in the Valley of Rephaim on the north; and it descended to the Valley of Hinnom, to the southern slope of the Jebusites, and descended to En-rogel.
verses.18:17: Then it curved northward and went out to En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which lies opposite the ascent of Adummim, and descended to the Stone of Bohan, son of Reuben.
verses.18:18: It passed on to the slope facing the Arabah on the north and descended into the Arabah.
verses.18:19: Then the boundary passed over to the slope of Beth-hoglah on the north, and the outer limits of the boundary were at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the southern end of the Jordan. This is the southern boundary.
verses.18:20: And the Jordan formed its boundary on the east side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to its boundaries all around, by their clans.
verses.18:21: Now the cities belonging to the tribe of the sons of Benjamin by their clans were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
verses.18:24: Chephar-ammonah, Ophni, and Geba: twelve cities and their villages.
verses.18:28: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite—that is, Jerusalem—Gibeath, and Kiriath: fourteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin by their clans.
verses.19:1: Then the second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans; and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Judah.
verses.19:2: They had in their inheritance Beersheba, Sheba, and Moladah;
verses.19:6: and Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen: thirteen cities and their villages.
verses.19:7: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: four cities and their villages,
verses.19:8: and all the villages that were around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negev. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their clans.
verses.19:9: Out of the allotment of the sons of Judah came the inheritance of the sons of Simeon, for the portion of the sons of Judah was too large for them; so the sons of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.
verses.19:10: Then the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their clans. And the border of their inheritance extended as far as Sarid.
verses.19:11: Then their border went up westward and to Maralah, and reached Dabbesheth, and reached to the brook that is opposite Jokneam.
verses.19:12: From Sarid it turned eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth-tabor; then it went out to Daberath and went up to Japhia.
verses.19:13: From there it passed on eastward toward the sunrise to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; and it went out to Rimmon, curving toward Neah.
verses.19:14: Then the border circled around it on the north to Hannathon, and its endpoints were at the Valley of Iphtahel.
verses.19:15: And Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities and their villages.
verses.19:16: This was the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their clans, these cities and their villages.
verses.19:17: For Issachar the fourth lot came out, for the sons of Issachar according to their clans.
verses.19:18: Their territory was Jezreel, Chesulloth, and Shunem;
verses.19:21: and Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
verses.19:22: The border also reached Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh, and the endpoints of their border were at the Jordan: sixteen cities and their villages.
verses.19:23: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
verses.19:24: Then the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their clans.
verses.19:25: Their territory was Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph;
verses.19:26: and Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it reached Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath.
verses.19:27: Then it turned toward the sunrise to Beth-dagon, and reached Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtahel northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; then it went out to Cabul on the north,
verses.19:28: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Great Sidon.
verses.19:29: Then the border turned to Ramah and as far as the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and its endpoints were at the sea, from the region of Achzib.
verses.19:30: And Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities and their villages.
verses.19:31: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their clans, these cities and their villages.
verses.19:32: For the sons of Naphtali the sixth lot came out, for the sons of Naphtali according to their clans.
verses.19:33: Their border ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, and its endpoints were at the Jordan.
verses.19:34: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and went out from there to Hukkok; it reached Zebulun on the south, and reached Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
verses.19:35: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth;
verses.19:38: and Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh: nineteen cities and their villages.
verses.19:39: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
verses.19:40: For the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans, the seventh lot came out.
verses.19:41: The territory of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh;
verses.19:46: and Me-jarkon and Rakkon, with the territory opposite Joppa.
verses.19:47: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their clans, these cities and their villages.
verses.19:48: Now the territory of the sons of Dan slipped away from them; so the sons of Dan went up and fought against Leshem and captured it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and took possession of it and settled in it; and they called Leshem Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.19:49: When they finished apportioning the land as an inheritance according to its borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua son of Nun in their midst.
verses.19:50: At the command of the LORD they gave him the city that he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city and settled in it.
verses.19:51: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the ancestral houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
verses.20:1: Then the LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.20:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Designate for yourselves the cities of refuge about which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.20:3: so that a killer who strikes down a person unintentionally, without knowledge, may flee there; and they shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood.'"
verses.20:7: So they consecrated Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah.
verses.20:8: And beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau, from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.
